title: HAPPY NEW MONTH 🤝
body:
If I could talk to myself when I first started trading, I’d say this:

You have way less time than you think. ⏳
Stop repeating mistakes you already know are mistakes. 
Stop waiting to feel ready.
Stop looking for another strategy. 📊
Stop blaming the market.
Stop saying you’ll get disciplined “next week.” ❌

You already know what you need to work on:

🎯 Risk management
⚡ Execution
🧘 Patience
💪 Discipline
🧠 Emotions

The traders who improve are the ones who confront their weaknesses instead of repeating them for years.

Take this seriously now, so you don’t look back wishing you started sooner. 🚀📈

title: EXPERIENCE IS THE BEST TEACHER 🤝
body:
There’s one part of trading nobody can teach you: intuition. 🧠📈

I can teach you how to: • Read trends & price action 📊
• Use volume & key levels 🔍
• Spot breakouts & quality setups 🎯

But I can’t teach you that feeling when something doesn’t look right… or the confidence that comes from seeing the same patterns over and over.

That only comes from EXPERIENCE. ⏳

And experience comes from repetition:

📚 Study charts
👀 Watch price action
📝 Journal your trades & emotions
🔄 Backtest your setups
❌ Review your mistakes

Do it again and again. Eventually, you’ll start spotting patterns faster and noticing small changes without overthinking every move. ⚡

That’s intuition built from hours of screen time. 🖥️📈

I can shorten your learning curve, but I can’t give you the screen time.

Put in the work. It will pay off. 🎯🔥

title: EVERY L IS A LESSON 🤲
body:
I'm a big believer that when a leading stock pulls back to test the 8 EMA for the first time, it's always worth a shot! 📈🎯

Took my chances on $INTC & $META today using a 15m pivot setup. 📊

Unfortunately, got stopped out on both. 📉

But that's the beauty of buying pullbacks. Your risk is usually around 1% down to the lows. 💡

❌ When you lose, you lose small. ✅ When you win, you win BIG! 💰🚀

Protect your capital, manage your risk, and let your winners run. That's the goal! 🎯🔥

title: KEEP GRINDING 💪

IMAGINE MAKING SOMEONE'S SALARY IN A SINGLE DAY, OFF OF ONE $SPY TRADE 🤯💸
